blurb: A historic site, museum, working blacksmith and artisans goods shop. Old Austerlitz Historical Society, founded in 1988, features historic homes and buildings from the 18th and 19th centuries.Located 6 miles from the Berkshire/Columbia County line and less than 10 minutes off I-90 in picturesque Austerlitz, New York.
